Voditelji se smenjuju u parovima i kroz dinamičan i neposredan razgovor otvaraju različite životne i društvene teme – od zdravlja, porodice i međuljudskih odnosa do svakodnevnih dilema, praktičnih saveta i priča koje zaslužuju pažnju. Uz goste u studiju i priče sa terena, Popodne prati ono što zanima i dotiče gledaoce, u opuštenoj atmosferi i uz mnogo prostora za iskrene razgovore, korisne odgovore i dobru energiju.

programme.title: Rosalinda
programme.desc: Dok služi svoju zatvorsku kaznu, žena dobija dete. Kako bi dobila život koji zaslužuje, dete odlazi da živi sa svojom tetkom.

programme.title: Popodne
programme.desc: Popodne od 16.30 časova, uz Anu Šupić i Boška Jakovljevića, donosi pregled aktuelnih tema iz zemlje i sveta, razgovore sa relevantnim sagovornicima i priče reportera sa terena. Poseban prostor posvećen je društvu i kulturi – temama koje pokreću javnost, zanimljivim ljudima i događajima koji obeležavaju svakodnevicu, uz razgovore koji nude različite poglede i odgovore na aktuelna pitanja. Uz poznate ličnosti, priče iz sveta kulture i zabave i muziku benda u studiju, Ana i Boško završnicu dana provode sa gledaocima u prepoznatljivoj atmosferi Popodneva – spontano, neposredno i uz dobru energiju.

programme.title: Gradske priče
programme.desc: Gradske priče su novi serijal Una televizije koji beleži neprolazne priče iz prestonice i drugih delova Srbije. Ovo su priče o stanovnicima gradova Srbije i urbanom okruženju koje ih je takvim napravilo. Teme ove emisije nisu aktuelni događaji, već sve ono što atmosferu grada čini jedinstvenom i neponovljivom. Najstrmija ulica, dan sa čistačem cipela, prva kafana u Evropi, najbolji beogradski đaci, najstariji vozač autobusa, pekara koja postoji 100 godina, žena koja godinama popravlja kišobrane, najteže beogradske škole, najbolji beogradski lekari, mesta za okupljanje, sastanke i rekreaciju, čudesna istorija, robinzoni sa Ratnog ostrva, ljudi sa čudnim hobijima, najlepši beogradski balkon, avanture dostavljača hrane, jutro u samačkom hotelu, dan u birou za izgubljene stvari, kako su nastajale tolike pesme u kojima se spominje Beograd, najduži red za pljeskavicu posle noćnog izlaska, tajna najboljeg beogradskog bureka, cenkanje na pijacama, spokojna šetnja u sred noći - sve je to duh jednog grada u kome svaki ćošak krije priču a svaki prolaznik neponovljivu anegdotu.

programme.title: Una Dan
programme.desc: Una dan, centralna dnevna informativna emisija Una televizije, emituje se svakog dana u 18 časova i donosi najvažnije domaće i svetske vesti, precizno i pravovremeno. Kroz nepristrasno i prodorno novinarstvo, uz lokalni ugao posmatranja, Una dan gledaocima pruža jasan pregled dana. Vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i primena virtuelne stvarnosti, doprinose modernom i dinamičnom doživljaju informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Alo, alo
programme.desc: Alo, Alo! je kultna britanska humoristična serija, koja se u originalnu prikazivala od 1982. do 1992. godine, u devet sezona. Autori serije su Jeremy Lloyd i David Croft. Radnja serije se odvija tokom Drugog svetskog rata, a glavni lik je René François Artois, vlasnik malog kafea u gradiću Nouvionu. Gradić su okupirali Nemci koji su iz njega pokrali sva vredna umetnička dela, među kojima su i prvi ikada napravljeni sat s kukavicom te Van Klompovu sliku Posrnula Bogorodica. Zapovednik grada želi sliku zadržati za sebe pa je daje Renéu da je sakrije u svom kafiću. Ali sliku želi i Gestapo koji šalje Ottoa Flicka da je nađe. U isto vreme Renéov kafić služi kao skrovište dvojici hrabrih ali priglupih oborenih britanskih pilota, a René je primoran raditi za Pokret otpora inače će biti ubijen zato što uslužuje Nemce. René se takođe trudi da balansira između afera s konobaricama Ivet, Mariom i Mimi i braka sa Idit.

programme.title: Tereza
programme.desc: Tereza je lepa i inteligentna devojka koja ne pristaje na život u siromaštvu. Iako je okružena ljubavlju porodice i Marijana, mladića koji je iskreno voli, ona sanja o bogatstvu, luksuzu i društvenom ugledu. Odlučna da sakrije svoje skromno poreklo, koristi šarm i lepotu kako bi postala deo sveta kojem oduvek želi da pripada. Posle ljubavnog razočaranja i poniženja, njena želja za uspehom postaje još snažnija. U bogatom i uglednom profesoru Arturu vidi priliku da zauvek promeni svoj život, ali osećanja prema Marijanu ne prestaju da je prate. Rastrzana između ljubavi i ambicije, Tereza ulazi u mrežu laži, spletki i izdaja, rizikujući da na putu do svega što želi izgubi one koji je najviše vole.

programme.title: Zabranjena ljubav
programme.desc: Žade, mlada muslimanka odgajana po strogim pravilima tradicije u Maroku, zaljubljuje se u Brazilca Lukasa, mladića potpuno drugačijeg sveta i vrednosti. Njihova ljubav, snažna i iskrena, suočava se sa nepremostivim preprekama – verskim zakonima, porodičnim pritiscima i sudbinom koja ih razdvaja onda kada se najmanje nadaju. U isto vreme, naučnik dr Albieri, slomljen gubitkom bliske osobe, donosi kontroverznu odluku – da klonira čoveka. Tako nastaje Leo, mladić koji nosi Lucasov lik, ali ne i njegovu prošlost. Njegovo postojanje otvara pitanja identiteta, morala i granica nauke, dok se sudbine Jade, Lukasa i Lea ponovo prepliću. Zabranjena ljubav je emotivna i slojevita saga o strasti, sudaru tradicije i modernog sveta, o iskušenjima vere, ljubavi i nauke – i o tome da li je moguće pobediti sudbinu.

programme.title: Jedno pitanje
programme.desc: Ovaj jedinstveni kviz nije samo test znanja već nesvakidašnja kombinacija znanja, igre i super zabave. Za osvajanje novčane nagrade od čak 500.000,00 dinara takmičarima su potrebni intuicija, malo sreće i nezaobilazna podrška šarmantne voditeljke Marije Kilibarde. Pravila su jednostavna: svaki takmičarski par dobija jedno pitanje i 16 ponuđenih odgovora. Kroz sistem eliminacije, pokušavaju da pronađu jedini tačan odgovor, i uz pažljivo razmišljanje i mrvu odvažnosti, nagrada može biti njihova.

programme.title: Grand Budapest hotel
programme.desc: Radnja prati gospodina Gistava, šarmantnog i posvećenog konsijerža luksuznog hotela, koji biva lažno optužen za ubistvo bogate grofice nakon što mu ona u testamentu ostavi neprocenjivu sliku. U poteri koja sledi, Gistavu pomaže njegov odani potrčko, mladi Zero.

programme.title: Pandorina kutija: Oslobađanje zla
programme.desc: Nakon što zaustavi neopreznog vozača, policajac otkrije cijeli niz ubojstava. Policija prati sadističkog i krvoločnog ubojicu koji voli mučiti i pljačkati.

programme.title: Pandorina kutija: Oslobađanje zla
programme.desc: Sumnjivi nestanak obiteljskog čovjeka Codyja Bowelsa uzbuni mjesnu policiju. Rutinska istraga otkriva hladnokrvnog ubojicu s promjenljivom prošlošću.

programme.title: Kućna ubojstva
programme.desc: Dom. To je mjesto na kojem se osjećamo sigurno, sigurno, voljeno i u miru, ali nisu svi domovi toliko sretni...

programme.title: Kućna ubojstva
programme.desc: Dom. To je mjesto na kojem se osjećamo sigurno, sigurno, voljeno i u miru, ali nisu svi domovi toliko sretni...

programme.title: Noćna mora iz susjedstva
programme.desc: Razne žrtve nestaju iz svojih zajednica, da bi se otkrilo da ih je ubio netko koga su poznavale. Istražitelji spajaju komadiće priče koja podsjeća na klasične detektivske romane.

programme.title: Noćna mora iz susjedstva
programme.desc: Poslije nenadanog nestanka Michaela Severancea, cijela zajednica iz San Angela okupi se oko njegove novopečene supruge. No možda se iza njegova nestanka krije nešto zlokobno?

programme.title: Zločin u stvarnom vremenu
programme.desc: Dokumentarni serijal "Zločin u stvarnom vremenu" bavi se potresnim zločinima koji su zabilježeni na nadzornim kamerama.

programme.title: Zločin u stvarnom vremenu
programme.desc: Dokumentarni serijal "Zločin u stvarnom vremenu" bavi se potresnim zločinima koji su zabilježeni na nadzornim kamerama.

programme.title: Granična kontrola: Europa
programme.desc: Carinske i sigurnosne službe na granicama europskih zemalja moraju stalno biti u pripravnosti kako bi spriječile da droga, oružje i sumnjivi teroristi prijeđu granicu.

programme.title: Granična kontrola: Europa
programme.desc: Carinske i sigurnosne službe na granicama europskih zemalja moraju stalno biti u pripravnosti kako bi spriječile da droga, oružje i sumnjivi teroristi prijeđu granicu.

programme.title: Granična kontrola Poljska
programme.desc: Sigurnosne i carinske službe na poljskoj granici neprestano motre kako bi spriječile ulazak ilegalne robe u zemlju. Njihov je posao otkrivanje kriminala.

programme.title: Pozivi iznutra
programme.desc: Dok osumnjičenici čekaju svoja suđenja, imaju priliku telefonirati. Ponekad ti razgovori otkrivaju važne detalje koji se ispostave ključnim za istrage.

programme.desc: Elizabeth Chambers donosi ovaj zanimljiv serijal u kojem istražuje toksične i nezdrave odnose među parovima. Nakon što je i sama doživjela skandalozan prekid, Elizabeth se osobno povezuje sa...

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kylien 18-i rođendan pruža Kris razlog da se sretne s Caitlyn po prvi put. Kim "preuzima" Krisin dom radi priprema za drugu bebu.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Khloé i Tristan nailaze na neke prepreke, Scott se suočava s velikim odlukama, a Kim se priprema za test koji će odrediti njezinu budućnost kao odvjetnice.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kim pokušava snimiti cijelu sedmu sezonu "Yeezya" dok je u Japanu, ali boji se da bi sestrin osjećaj za modu mogao ugroziti cijeli debi.

programme.title: Gledaj što se događa: Uživo s Andyjem Cohenom
programme.desc: Živahne rasprave o najvrućim temama iz pop kulture sa slavnim osobama i protagonistima reality emisija. Gosti iz najpopularnijih serija i druge šoubiz zvijezde razgovaraju o poznatim licima iz vijesti...

programme.title: Vrlo Cavallari
programme.desc: Kristin i Brittainy idu u Los Angeles otvoriti trgovinu "Neuobičajeni James Pop", dok je u Nashvilleu osoblje na testu tijekom cyber-ponedjeljka.

programme.title: Vrlo Cavallari
programme.desc: Kristin se emotivno prisjeća trenutaka iz prošlosti dok završava posjetu Laguni. Chuy okuplja svih za svoju godišnju zabavu.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Dok se LA suočava s blokadom, Khloé se brine da bi mogla imati Covid-19, Malika dobiva trudove, a Kris je shrvana što ne može biti s majkom zbog sigurnosti.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kim se trudi uskladiti posao i život mame, a Khloé postaje kreativna kako bi se zabavila. Obitelj potiče Kendall i Kylie na pomirenje.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kada Kylie završi srednju školu, Kris odlučuje pripremiti ekstra posebnu zabavu. Kim njena trudnička žudnja vodi po cijelom svijetu.

Fighting Season
programme.desc: A fact-based movie going behind the scenes of recruiting soldiers for the US Army at the end of the first decade of the 21st century. In this rough time, so unfavourable for the soldiery, enlisting volunteers required non-standard actions and some methods of military recruiters could be considered controversial.

programme.title: Hindsight
programme.desc: Unexpectedly pregnant with no means to raise a child, Dina (MIRANDA BAILEY) and Ronnie (WAYLON PAYNE) decide to sell their unborn baby over the Internet. Their plan begins to unravel when the couple they've chosen, Paul (JEFFREY DONOVAN) and Maria (LEANOR VARELA), turn out to have an agenda of their own.

programme.title: Hell House LLC Origins: The Carmichael Manor
Owd Bob
programme.desc: The story of a young orphaned boy who is sent to live with his grandfather in Ireland. The boy finds adjusting to the country life challenging, but soon learns the life has its rewards as well.

programme.title: Whisper Island
programme.desc: Sam Dalton, a 14-year-old girl, is determined to save the only home she has ever known, the faded, dusty Romanian Princess ranch. Sam writes to a distant relative of her Aunt Christine hoping he can prevent the ranch from being repossessed. But it's J. T. Swinton, a teenage boy who shows up. In desperation they turn to a seemingly futile hope, the treasure of Whisper Island. But does the Civil War treasure really exist? The answer seems to be trapped somewhere in the wishful delusions of Aunt Christine. As the teens search for treasure in a race against time, they must also search Christine's past and unravel a web of romance, intrigue and betrayal that spans a lifetime and beyond. What they find, changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Trattoria
programme.desc: This funny and heartwarming dramedy set in the exciting San Francisco culinary scene follows Sal Sartini, a workaholic chef who must learn to rekindle his passion for cooking and love, and repair the bond he has with his son before he risks losing everything again.

programme.title: Redemption of the Ghost
programme.desc: Convicted embezzler Witt Hampton escapes from prison and while hiding out in an isolated country barn is discovered by young Cassy and her brother Jack. After convincing them he's a friendly ghost that only they can see, the three new friends embark on one imaginative adventure after another until, inspired by their innocent spirits, Witt vows to redeem his crimes. But, a by-the-book sheriff-who has sworn to personally put Hampton back behind bars-is closing in, and Witt may never get the chance to finally set things right.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
Alex of Venice
programme.desc: A workaholic attorney is forced to reinvent her life after her husband suddenly leaves.

programme.title: Alex of Venice
programme.desc: A workaholic attorney is forced to reinvent her life after her husband suddenly leaves.

programme.title: Departure
programme.desc: A man leaves a woman, a woman leaves a man. Both meet for a short while. Great changes await them at the end of this journey.

programme.title: Little Crumb: Race To the Gold Mine
programme.desc: Little Crumb is finally reunited with his parents, and now he is no longer a street urchin. He enjoys a splendid villa with his Mom and Dad. His days are peaceful and calm, and boring, as he does not have the excitement and adventures he is used to while living in a big city. He decides to run away and take his dog with him. Anna tries to stop him, but they are both kidnapped by the old enemy of the family. Now he has to use tall the skills and lifehacks of his new and his old life to escape and save his family.

programme.title: Heidi
programme.desc: A story of a young girl who lives in the Swiss Alps with her goat herding Grandfather.

programme.title: North & South: The Battle of New Market
programme.desc: Based on a true story of the American Civil War, culminating at the Battle of New Market, May 1864. A group of teenage cadets sheltered from war at the Virginia Military Institute must confront the horrors of an adult world when they are called upon to defend the Shenandoah Valley. Leaving behind their youth, these cadets must decide what they are fighting for.

programme.title: Daydream Believers: The Monkees' Story
programme.desc: In 1966, producers Bert Schneider and Bob Rafaelson come up with the idea of creating a TV show that would feature the American answer to the Beatles, The Monkees. Eventually, four young men are chosen for the roles, Mickey Dolenz the former child TV star, the stage actor Davey Jones and the musicians, Mike Nesmith and Peter Tork. With the aid of a successful music producer and able TV promotion, the Monkees become a sensation. However, that success is tainted, to the chagrin of the band, as they find themselves labeled as talentless phonies. This film covers the band's frustrating struggle to prove their detractors wrong as they struggle to earn some artist legitimacy. Whether it's by learning to excel as a band or experimenting with wild ideas for their show and film, Head, nothing seems to work. Meanwhile the band have their internal tensions as various members struggle to decide what is really important to them...

programme.title: The Ambassador to Bern
programme.desc: Attila Szasz's political thriller portraying the events of the hostage taking of the Hungarian ambassador to Switzerland in the aftermath of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution. The film was presented at numerous festivals all over the world. It won the Frederico Fellini Award at Tiburon International Film Festival.

programme.title: Fame
programme.desc: An updated version of the 1980 musical, which centered on the students of the New York Academy of Performing Arts.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: Chef Carl Casper runs the kitchen of a thriving Los Angeles restaurant. Before the arrival of a leading restaurant critic, Carl wants to experiment with a new menu, but the commercial restaurant owner will not allow that. The result is a devastating review.

programme.title: Hard Ball
programme.desc: When a compulsive gambler (Keanu Reeves) is unable to pay a debt he owes to his friend, he is given the choice to payback the debt by coaching an inner-city little league baseball team. Taking on this new challenge gives him a new outlook on life, as well as the kids on the team. Based upon the book, "Hardball: A Season in the Projects", by Daniel Coyle.

programme.title: Riff Raff
programme.desc: Vincent is an ex-criminal who more than anything, just wants a normal, peaceful life. He and his wife Sandy, have built a loving family with their son DJ and are spending their last summer in a cabin before he goes off to college. Chaos ensues when Vincent's disowned son Rocco, his girlfriend Marina, and Vincent's ex-wife Ruth abruptly show up to spoil the festivities with an ominous warning: famed gangsters Leftie and Lonnie are coming for them.

programme.title: Australijski gangster
programme.desc: Luksuzna novogodišnja proslava na brodu loše se završava, što kod Barbarove nove ekipe stvara napetost. Avganistanac optužuje Barbara da je upleten, a jedan od ubica zaduženih za Antonovo ubistvo, još uvek se nije pojavio. Barbaro ga smiruje i govori mu da je njihov posao pri kraju i da će uskoro biti kraljevi grada.

programme.title: Australijski gangster
programme.desc: Luksuzna novogodišnja proslava na brodu loše se završava, što kod Barbarove nove ekipe stvara napetost. programme.title: U kandžama lopova
programme.desc: Kada Džejk, čuvar obezbeđenja u malom hotelu, nenamerno pomogne prelepoj pljačkašici, postaje glavni osumnjičeni i odmah ga otpuštaju. Džejk odlučuje da sam prati pljačkašicu i povrati ukradenu imovinu.

programme.title: Mračna voda
programme.desc: Tajni operativac budi se i shvata da je CIA poslala njegovu podmornicu na nepoznatu lokaciju.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Vellčanstveni Ambersonovi
programme.desc: Razmaženo derište, Džordž Amberson, užasnut je kada njegova majka, odnedavno udovica, obnovi vezu s imućnim Judžinom Morganom, koga je ostavila nekoliko decenija ranije, kako bi se udala za Džordžovog oca. Dok se Džordž trudi da sabotira romansu svoje majke, mora se nositi ii sa sopstvenim osećanjima prema Morganovoj ćerci.

programme.title: Njuškalo i ledena ptica
programme.desc: Njuškalo, nemačkog ovčara, odgajio je Tom. On je psa naučio mnogim posebnim veštinama i sa svojom devojkom Mirjam upada u uzbudljive avanture.U ovoj avanturi, Tom i njegovi prijatelji Njuškalo i Mirjam idu na jedrenje tokom letnjeg raspusta. Usput na vašaru sreću strašnu braću Džimija i Nilsa, kao i njihovog psa Lebasa. Tako počinje još jedna šerlokholmsovska avantura…

programme.title: Njuškalo u ratu
programme.desc: Nakon što su mu roditelji poginuli u bombardovanju tokom Drugog svetskog rata, Tomas u poslali da živi s rođacima na seoskoj farmi u Holandiji. On je tužan, ljut i uplašen i prezire što mora da živi sa tetkom i tečom.Ali kad Tom dobije da gaju nemačkog ovčara Njuškala, sve se iz korena menja. On sve svoje poverenje poklanja Njuškalu i zajedno se trude da izvuku najbolje od života iako je njihovo selo pod nemačkom kontrolom.Uz Njuškalovu pomoć Tom spasava holandskog pilota koji je oboren i ranjen. Ali kada holandski nacistički kolaboracionista pošalje vojnike da traže pilota, na Njuškalu i Tomu je da razotkriju izdajnika. Pilot uspeva da pobegne u svoju jedinicu, a Njuškalo nazad dovodi vojsku kako bi oslobodili grad."Njuškalo u ratu" je dostupno u dve verzije, kao dugometražni igrani film ili kao mini-serija od četiri polučasovne epizode.

programme.title: Kralj boraca
programme.desc: Film akcije na osnovi priče iz video igre " Kralj ratnika"

programme.title: Čovek od poverenja
programme.desc: Priča o Beriju Monkovu, mladom harizmatičnom biznismenu koji postaje imućni direktor i stiže do samog vrha uz pomoć laži, prevara i krađe.

programme.title: Vampirice
programme.desc: Dve vampirice u današnjem Njujorku suočavaju se sa zastrašujućim ljubavnim mogućnostima.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Ljubav na prvi lajk
programme.desc: Cinična novinarka dobija zadatak da piše o zavodniku sa dejting aplikacija, ali ubrzo otkriva da se iza njegove reputacije krije mnogo više od onoga što je očekivala.

programme.title: Poslednja potera
programme.desc: Godine 1909, Vili Boj i njegova voljena Karlota beže nakon što on u kobnom sukobu slučajno usmrti njenog oca. Dok se predsednik Taft sprema da poseti ovu oblast, lokalni šerif i dvojica indijanskih tragača kreću u poteru za čovekom kog smatraju ubicom svog plemenskog vođe.

programme.title: Ljubavnica
programme.desc: Četiri žene povezuje smrtonosna tajna koju ne smeju otkriti. Ko je onaj koga su ubile? Se-jon uz pomoć Sang-huna prati zagonetne pozive, dok Eun-su otkriva da joj je pacijent Sun-ho, sin bivšeg ljubavnika Min-džeja , kao i da nju sumnjiči da mu je ubila oca.

programme.title: Porodica na okupu
programme.desc: Četvoro polubraće i polusestara može naslediti po tri miliona dolara od svog oca, ako budu sarađivali kao porodica dve godine. Troje od njih odlazi u Meksiko kao lovci na ucene kako bi uhvatili begunca povezanog sa otmicom jednog milijardera.

programme.title: Smrtna kazna
programme.desc: Nik Hjum je povučen čovek, izvršni direktor sa savršenim životom, koji jedne večeri postaje svedok događaja koji ga zauvek menja. Ophrvan tugom, Hjum dolazi do uznemirujućeg zaključka da ne postoji granica koju neće preći kako bi zaštitio svoju porodicu.

programme.title: Smrtna kazna
programme.desc: Nik Hjum je povučen čovek, izvršni direktor sa savršenim životom, koji jedne večeri postaje svedok događaja koji ga zauvek menja. Ophrvan tugom, Hjum dolazi do uznemirujućeg zaključka da ne postoji granica koju neće preći kako bi zaštitio svoju porodicu.

programme.title: Savršena žena
programme.desc: Lia je svom bratu Rubenu bila kao majka, sve dok ga jednog dana nije pokosio i ubio pijani bajker. Od tog trenutka, na umu ima samo osvetu, a platiće svi: od vozača motora, koji je u komi, do lekara koji nije uspeo da spase život njenom bratu.

programme.title: Zdravo za gotovo
programme.desc: Dva stara prijatelja iz policijske škole ponovo se susreću nakon što su im se putevi potpuno razišli. Onaj koji je s druge strane zakona uvlači onog ispravnog u svoj raskošni život, koji je nasledio od nedavno ubijenog prijatelja.

programme.title: Sumnja
programme.desc: Darel Džejkobs je penzionisani mafijaš koji živi u Finiksu. Kada oboli od raka, shvata da mu vreme ističe, pa svakodnevno posećuje svoj omiljeni kafić. Mlada konobarica Ališa Foret, studentkinja prava, zaintrigirana je tajanstvenim redovnim gostom, pa ga prati do kuće. Ubrzo započinje prijateljstvo koje Ališu dovodi u opasnost i primorava Darela da dovrši "nesvršena posla". Ališin momak Tom ne odobrava njihovo prijateljstvo, pa ih prati. Kada otkrije Darelov pravi identitet, Tom upada u paniku, ali ne zbog bezbednosti svoje devojke, već zbog sopstvene.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Njuškalo i lov na letećeg fantoma
programme.desc: Rat je završen i selom je zavladao mir. Ali onda, iznenada, tajanstvena prilika u crnom počinje da vreba seljane. Legenda kaže da se ponovo vratio Leteći fantom. Tom, njegova devojka Mirjam i Njuškalo kreću u istragu. Zahvaljujući Njuškalovim posebnim sposobnostima, fantom je uhvaćen u zamku, a zlokobna zavera ubistva i osvete otkrivena je baš na vreme!

programme.title: Loša genetika
programme.desc: Žena koja je ostavljena jedanaest puta, otkriva (na svoje zaprepašćenje) da ima gubitničke ljubavne gene.

programme.title: Gorko-slatko
programme.desc: Ekscentrični i bogati trgovac kafom, šalje priznatog stručnjaka u Tajland, gde treba da otkupi novu, egzotičnu vrstu kafe. Njegov "savršen" život ispada iz koloseka kad se, nakon prvobitne netrpeljivosti, zaljubljuje u prelepu ćerku vlasnika plantaže, a onda otkriva da ga šef ustvari uopšte nije poslao zbog kupovine kafe.

programme.title: Šta sve činimo zbog ljubavi
programme.desc: Ambiciozna Sofi napušta mali posrednički biro i prelazi u prestižnu firmu Floating Lotus na Menhetnu. Kao pomoćni posrednik brzo ulazi u sukob sa harizmatičnim Džejsonom Šarpom, sinom vlasnika i kompanijinim lajf koučem. Ipak, njih dvoje primorani su da rade zajedno.

programme.title: Njuškalo i ukleti dvorac
programme.desc: Njuškala, nemačkog ovčara, odgajio je Tom. On je psa naučio mnogim posebnim veštinama i sa svojom devojkom Mirjam upada u uzbudljive avanture. Tokom letnjeg raspusta Tom ostaje s Mirjam i Njuškalom kod svog čika Hansa i bratanca Jaapa. Čuli su za ukleti dvorac u susedstvu. Legenda o ovom dvorcu kaže da se u srednjem veku izvesni vitez Betram zaljubio u sluškinju Ejdu, ali je ona već bila zaljubljena u konjušara. Betram rešava da se na užasan način osveti ovo dvoje i od tada se priča da je šuma oko dvorca ukleta. Na putu kroz šumu do dvorca, Tom, Mirjam i Njuškalo prate bandu krijumčara. To ih ponovo vodi u uzbudljivu avanturu…

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Dženino venčanje
programme.desc: U gradiću u kom je rođena, niko ne shvata zašto se Dženi, najlepša i najpopularnija devojka iz kraja, još uvek nije udala. Kruže glasine da je ljubavnica oženjenog muškarca u "velikom gradu" u kom sada živi, zbog čega nikoga ne dovodi sa sobom na venčanje svog školskog druga. Njeni roditelji očajnički žele da se skrasi. Ipak, Dženina objava venčanja, kada do toga konačno dođe, nije ono što je bilo ko od njih očekivao.

programme.title: Pravo mesto i vreme za pisanje
programme.desc: Paigeina majka želi da kći krene njenim stopama i preuzme vođenje velikog konglomerata, no Paige želi biti spisateljica. Kada Joan odluči prodati izdavačku kuću Atlas zbog manjka klijenata i prihoda, Paige to vidi kao priliku da joj pruži posljednju šansu — ovaj put pišući pod pseudonimom, tako da nitko, pa ni Daniel, posljednja nada izdavača, ne zna da upravo njena obitelj predstavlja prijetnju.

programme.title: Tomiris
programme.desc: Tomiris, kraljica Amazonki, povela je 600 godina pre nove ere krvavi rat protiv Persijskog carstva. Kada persijski kralj Kir uništi njeno selo, ona okuplja ogromnu vojsku da oslobodi svoj narod. Slede spektakularne bitke, borbe na život i smrt i spletke surovog kralja koji silom i prevarama želi da pokori narod.

programme.title: Ljubavnica
programme.desc: Jedan nepromišljeni trenutak izaziva šokantnu nesreću. Jung-von pokušava da odbije Min-gjua, ali je muževljevo, Dong-sokovo, sve jezivije ponašanje gura nazad ka njemu. Se-jon otkriva tragove o pokojnom mužu i stiže do zastrašujuće lokacije. Eun-su oslobađa se sumnje od strane Sun-hoa i počinje da razotrkiva istinu o događajima kobne noći.

programme.title: Pion
programme.desc: Sitna pljačka prerasta u napetu talačku krizu kada trojica naoružanih napadača opljačkaju restoran koji služi kao paravan za mafijaške poslove.

programme.title: Dobri komšija
programme.desc: Dvojica nestašnih srednjoškolaca uspešno uveravaju svog vremešnog komšiju da u njegovoj kući ima duhova. Međutim, niz nesrećnih okolnosti pretvara njihovu bezazlenu šalu u tragediju.

programme.title: Dobri komšija
programme.desc: Dvojica nestašnih srednjoškolaca uspešno uveravaju svog vremešnog komšiju da u njegovoj kući ima duhova. Međutim, niz nesrećnih okolnosti pretvara njihovu bezazlenu šalu u tragediju.

programme.title: Nema šuma
programme.desc: Studentkinja šumarstva Anja Grim dolazi na praksu u šumu u kojoj je njen otac nestao kada je imala osam godina. Dok uzima uzorke tla, otkriva određene nepravilnosti, ali se ubrzo događa brutalno ubistvo. Njena pitanja o zemljištu i prošlosti izazivaju sumnju i neprijateljstvo meštana.

programme.title: Zavejani
programme.desc: Dvoje novopečenih prijatelja pokušavaju da pobegnu ostavljenom ljubavniku, koji traži svoj novac i još ponešto.

programme.title: Brzina misli
programme.desc: Džošua Lazarus je "skuper" _ telepata sposoban da čuje ljudske misli. U svetu ih ima samo nekoliko i uz obuku mogu kontrolisati glasove u glavi. Njegov dar je smrtonosan, jer skuperi polude u 29. godini, a Džošua ima 28. On i mentor rade za vladu u zamenu za lek. Tokom misije upoznaje neobučenu skuperku Anu i ubrzo se zaljubljuju. Vlada ne može to da dozvoli, i oni pokušavaju da pobegnu i započnu novi život zajedno, ali bivaju otkriveni i razdvojeni. Uz pomoć prijatelja iz detinjstva, Džošua mora da razotkrije istinu o svojim sposobnostima, korupciji i moći kojom može spasiti budućnost.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Ljubav i Meri
programme.desc: Meri je profinjena poslastičarka. Trudi se da održi svoju poslastičarnicu, ali jednog dana izbacivanje iz poslovnog prostora primorava je da zatvori posao. Meri sa svojim verenikom Brentom odlučuje da otputuje kod svoje porodice u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću, Brent dobija napad alergije koji ga sprečava da krene na put. Meri odlučuje da sa sobom povede Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca, koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora, i predstavi ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to biti dobra ideja?

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Julije Cezar
programme.desc: Epohalan prikaz Julija Cezara, posljednjeg diktatora Rima, čija smrt je također označila kraj Rimske Republike. Priča o njegovim kampanjama u Galiji i Egiptu, njegovoj rivalstvu s generalom Pompejem i konačnom atentatu pod rukama Bruta i Kasija.

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Vellčanstveni Ambersonovi
programme.desc: Razmaženo derište, Džordž Amberson, užasnut je kada njegova majka, odnedavno udovica, obnovi vezu s imućnim Judžinom Morganom, koga je ostavila nekoliko decenija ranije, kako bi se udala za Džordžovog oca. Dok se Džordž trudi da sabotira romansu svoje majke, mora se nositi ii sa sopstvenim osećanjima prema Morganovoj ćerci.

programme.title: Satin
programme.desc: Propali pevač iz Las Vegasa, Džek Satin, nema novca, nema posao i u zabludi je da će se proslaviti. Kada je primoran da napusti Vegas, seda u svoj stari kadilak i odlazi u Atlantik Siti. Tamo upoznaje Loren, vlasnicu lokalnog bara, koja mu pomaže da shvati da je život mnogo više od puke jurnjave za slavom i bogatstvom.

programme.title: Nestala
programme.desc: Kad njena sestra nestane, Džil je ubeđena da se vratio serijski ubica koji ju je kidnapovao pre dve godine. Spremna je da se još jednom suoči s čovekom koji ju je oteo.

programme.title: Istina o lažima
programme.desc: Gilbi se zatiče u zamršenoj mreži laži, jer je istinu preteško priznati, a još teže prihvatiti.

programme.title: Skoro prijatelji
programme.desc: Čarli, neambiciozni muškarac u srednjim dvadesetim godinama koji i dalje živi s majkom i očuhom i zaljubljuje se u mladu ženu koja je u vezi s ozbiljnim muškarcem.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Vredni advokat koji do posla dolazi tako što nasumično bira i posećuje zatvorenike upoznaje bivšeg igrača bejzbola, ujedno drugog čoveka jedne kriminalne organizacije. Hoće li uspeti da odoli iskušenjima zla?

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Situacija se preokreće za Han Dong-sua. Posle pretnji So Do-jonga, advokat je primoran da špijunira za svog klijenta.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Nakon što So Do-jong izađe iz zatvora, Han Dong-su i Han Dže-bom kuju plan da razotkriju njegovo kriminalno carstvo, dok se istovremeno bore sa sopstvenom savešću.

programme.title: Daughters, Wives and a Mother
programme.desc: Tashiro coincidentally meets his best friend Sugimoto in a bar very close to the apartment in which Sugimoto's wayward wife is found dead. Although Tashiro is not a suspect in the police investigation, he is racked with guilt and confesses to his wife, Masako. In an effort to further relieve his tortured sense of guilt, he then confesses to Sugimoto. Neither his wife nor his friend can believe that he could have been involved.

programme.title: Mother
programme.desc: A teenaged girl witnesses her widowed mother's attempt to sustain her family.

programme.title: The Phantom of 42nd Street
programme.desc: A theatre critic (Dave O'Brien) teams up with a cop (Jack Mulhall) to investigate the murder of a Broadway actor.

programme.title: The Gold Rush
programme.desc: A calm and content Little Tramp seeks his fortune in the hidden gold mines of the Klondike. All calm is quickly lost, however, when another prospector, just as famished as he is, begins mistaking him for a giant chicken. In this world where shoe laces become spaghetti and bread rolls become ballet shoes, Chaplin, the alchemist, turns gold into poetry.

programme.title: The Hoodlum
programme.desc: Vincent Lubeck is a vicious ex-convict. His criminal activities are despised by his family, but he uses and abuses them in the course of his crimes. Eventually his own brother must stand up to him

programme.title: A Woman's Life
programme.desc: A woman remember's her own marriage when dealing with the love life of her son.

programme.title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
programme.desc: Ruthless woman has her dark past of a concealed murder return.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. As first mate, Marshall recruits Ben Waldridge, a cashiered former British Navy captain. Waldridge brings his former gun crew...who begin plotting mutiny as soon as they learn there'll be gold aboard. The gold duly arrives, and with it Waldridge's former sweetheart Leslie, who's fond of a bit of gold herself. Which side is Waldridge really on?

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: When an only child is struck by a car and dies, the child's mother seeks vengeance against the driver in this thrilling drama. The car was driven by the wife of a company president who is having an affair. The woman's husband manages to buy silence about the incident, but the victim's mother discovers the identity of the driver. After she secures a job in the home of the company president and his philandering spouse, the woman plans to murder the couple's son when he reaches the age of her late son.

programme.title: The Inner Circle
programme.desc: A private detective finds himself with a perfect new secretary. But after a notorious gossip columnist turns up murdered, she may prove too good to be true.

programme.title: People Are Funny
programme.desc: A comedy based on NBC's "People Are Funny" radio (and later television) program with Art Linkletter with a fictional story of how the program came to be on a national network from its humble beginning at a Nevada radio station. Jack Haley is a producer with only half-rights to the program while Ozzie Nelson and Helen Walker are the radio writers and supply the romance. Rudy Vallee, always able to burlesque himself intentional and, quite often, unintentional, is the owner of the sought-after sponsoring company. Frances Langford, as herself, sings "I'm in the Mood for Love" while the Vagabonds quartet (billed 12th and last) chimes in on "Angeline" and "The Old Square Dance is Back Again."

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Paris
programme.desc: Love, marriage and heartache in paris after the war.

programme.title: Joan of Arkansas
programme.desc: When the U.S. Space program requires an ordinary person to become the first human in space, the Saraback Computer chooses Joan Jones, a scatter brained, good natured klutz who works as a dental technician.

programme.title: Till the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Songwriter and Broadway pioneer Jerome Kern is unable to find immediate success in the U.S. He sought recognition abroad. He journeyed to England where his dreams of success became real and where he met his future wife Eva Leale.

programme.title: The Parakeets
programme.desc: Lili, an ill young woman, is faced one morning with the sudden loss of her hair. The imagination of her friend Laura is going to change the course of a day, which had badly begun.

programme.title: Corpse Vanishes
programme.desc: A scientist, aided by an old hag and her two sons, kills virginal brides, steals their bodies, and extracts gland fluid to keep his ancient wife alive and young.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: Terror by Night
programme.desc: Holmes and Watson board a passenger train bound from London to Edinburgh, to guard the Star of Rhodesia, an enormous diamond worth a fortune belonging to an elderly woman of wealth; but within the first hour of the trip, the woman's son is murdered and the diamond stolen and any of the passengers in their car could be the killer thief.

programme.title: The Amazing Adventure
programme.desc: A bored millionaire wagers his doctor that he can support himself at a working class job for year without touching his inheritance.

programme.title: Club Paradise
programme.desc: A naive young girl, looking to escape from a bad family situation, falls in love with a man who turns out to be a cad, and leads her down the road to ruin.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: Buck Colins heads a group of local ranchers who are trying to prevent the railroad from completing its line through their property. Till now they have been able to charge tolls on herds passing through. Hoppy goes undercover to expose them.

programme.title: Life with Father
programme.desc: A financier from New York rules his numerous family, consisting of his wife and his four sons, with the meticulousness of a bookkeeper.

programme.title: The Man with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: When illegal card dealer and recovering heroin addict Frankie Machine gets out of prison, he decides to straighten up. Armed with nothing but an old drum set, Frankie tries to get honest work as a drummer. But when his former employer and his old drug dealer re-enter his life, Frankie finds it hard to stay clean and eventually finds himself succumbing to his old habits.

programme.title: Dead Men Walk
programme.desc: The twin of a kindly small-town physician returns from the grave for vengeance against his brother, who secretly killed him because the twin served Satan.

programme.title: Revenge of the Zombies
programme.desc: When Dr. Von Altermann's wife Lila dies mysteriously at his spooky mansion her relations suspect murder. They also suspect the doctor is turning her into a zombie, to join the army of living dead he hopes to devote to the Nazi cause. However, Lila, though dead, has developed a will of her own.

programme.title: Captain Calamity
programme.desc: A South Seas skipper fights off thieves and pirates who are after a lost treasure.

programme.title: The Captive Heart
programme.desc: A series of stories about the lives and loves of nine men in a Prisoner of War Camp over five years. Location shooting in the British occupied part of Germany adds believability. The main story is of Hasek (Redgrave) a Czech soldier who needs to keep his identity a secret from the Nazis, to do this he poses as a dead English Officer and corresponds with the man's wife. Upon liberation they meet and decide to continue their lives together. The other inmates' stories are revealed episodically.

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's a bloodthirsty plant, forcing him to kill to feed it.

programme.title: Wake Me When the War Is Over
programme.desc: During the final months of WW2, a lonely German Baroness hides an attractive American airman in her mansion for long time without telling him the war has been over for almost five years.

programme.title: Impact
programme.desc: A unfaithful wife plots with her lover to kill her husband, but the lover is accidentally killed instead. The husband stays in hiding and lets his wife be charged with conspiracy.

programme.title: The Trial
programme.desc: Josef K wakes up in the morning and finds the police in his room. They tell him that he is on trial but nobody tells him what he is accused of. In order to find out about the reason for this accusation and to protest his innocence, he tries to look behind the façade of the judicial system. But since this remains fruitless, there seems to be no chance for him to escape from this nightmare.

programme.title: The Murder in the Museum
programme.desc: When a city councilman is murdered while investigating allegations of drug dealing going on a a somewhat disreputable sideshow, the daughter of the chief suspect teams up with a newspaper reporter to find the real killer.

programme.title: Career Girl
programme.desc: Joan Terry, a girl from the country wants to become a Broadway Star, but this proves to be not so easy.

programme.title: 31 Hours
programme.desc: Stefan is an overworked surgeon who's just worked a thirty-one-hour shift. A last minute patient comes in and, as he is the only surgeon available, he goes in for one last operation before going home. Things do not go as planned though, and he loses the patient on the operating table. Starts a saga of deontological issues, where the corrupted Romanian health system comes under close scrutiny.

programme.title: A Farewell to Arms
programme.desc: A ravishing adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's legendary novel, A FAREWELL TO ARMS stars Gary Cooper as Lt. Frederic Henry, a young ambulance driver for the Italian army in WWI, more interested in chasing women than the enemy. When seeking cover during an air raid, he encounters Nurse Catherine Barkley, and the world shifts under his feet. They fall in love, but the war keeps wrenching them apart. These painful separations force Frederic to choose between love and battle, a decision that tests him morally and spiritually, and leads to one of the most rapturously romantic endings of all time.

programme.title: Voyage to the Prehistoric Planet
programme.desc: In 2020, after the colonization of the moon, the spaceships Vega, Sirius and Capella are launched from Lunar Station 7.

programme.title: AUN: The Beginning and the End of All Things
programme.desc: When looking for alternative energy sources, the Japanese scientist Sekai tragically dies. Twenty years later the Brazilian mathematician Euclides continues his research. The lack of an essential component won't allow a breakthrough. Only AUN, Sekai's son, seems to hold the key to protect mankind from self-destruction. In the aftermath of the nuclear tragedy in Fukushima the film appears like a prophecy. AUN's dream-like images, complemented by music from Christian Fennesz and Ryuichi Sakamoto, lead into a fantastic and exciting world, full of brightness and darkness of life.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Ageing, wealthy, rancher and self-made man, George Washington McLintock is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife—who left him two years previously—suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in George; she wants custody of their daughter.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Ageing, wealthy, rancher and self-made man, George Washington McLintock is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife—who left him two years previously—suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in George; she wants custody of their daughter.

programme.title: The Driver's Seat
programme.desc: Lise, a mentally unbalanced middle-aged woman, travels from her home in Copenhagen to Rome, Italy where she embarks on a fatal destiny, a premeditated search for someone, anyone, with whom she can form a dangerous liaison.

programme.title: Fear and Desire

programme.title: Edith

programme.title: It's a Joke, Son!
programme.desc: Claghorn gets into some financial difficulties and is forced by a machine-political gang to enter a race for state senator against his wife (Una Merkel) who appears to have a good chance to beat the political hack backed by the machine. Claghorn is in to siphon votes and ensure his wife's opponent will win and is expected to run a campaign that will defeat himself and his wife. But, he runs to win and the machine's henchies abduct him.

programme.title: Daughters, Wives and a Mother
programme.desc: Tashiro coincidentally meets his best friend Sugimoto in a bar very close to the apartment in which Sugimoto's wayward wife is found dead. Although Tashiro is not a suspect in the police investigation, he is racked with guilt and confesses to his wife, Masako. In an effort to further relieve his tortured sense of guilt, he then confesses to Sugimoto. Neither his wife nor his friend can believe that he could have been involved.

programme.title: Scarlet Street
programme.desc: A banned box-office hit, Scarlet Street is one of Fritz Lang's greatest American films. Middle-aged cashier Chris Cross rescues streetwise Kitty and tumbles into a spiral of desire, deception, and revenge. As his obsession grows, Chris is seduced, degraded, and transformed, while fate delivers a grimly ironic justice. Featuring standout performances by Joan Bennett and Dan Duryea, the film is packed with sharp twists and masterful direction—a classic, pitch-dark gem of film noir.

programme.title: Renegade Girl
programme.desc: Ann Shelby, whose family is allied with the notorious William Quantrill, turns outlaw to revenge herself on a renegade Indian who killed her brother.

programme.title: Captain Kidd
programme.desc: Cutthroat pirate William Kidd captures Admiral Blayne's treasure ship and hides the bounty in a cave. Three years later, Kidd, posing as a respectable merchant captain, offers his services to the King of England. Seeking a social position, Kidd also negotiates for Blayne's title and lands, provided he can prove Blayne was associated with piracy. Launched upon his royal mission, Kidd is unaware that Blayne's son Adam is among the crew, determined to clear his father's name.

programme.title: The End of Summer
programme.desc: The family of an older man who runs a small sake brewery become concerned with his finances and his health after they discover him visiting an old mistress from his youth.

programme.title: 'Neath the Arizona Skies
programme.desc: Chris Morrell, the guardian of half-Indian girl Nina, is helping her find her missing white father. so she can cash in on her late mother's oil lease. Outlaw Sam Black is after the girl and her father as well. Besides dealing with the Black gang, Morrell has to find another robber, Jim Moore, who switches clothes with him after he finds Chris unconscious from a fight with Sam Black. Along the way, he meets a lady who's the sister of Jim Moore, another bad hombre who's in cahoots with Jim Moore, and an old friend who takes in Nina and helps Chris locate Nina's father and fight off the various desperadoes

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Edison didn't invent the light bulb—he made it practical. Early lighting included unsafe limelight and blinding arc lamps. Edison tested thousands of filaments, even a beard hair, to improve bulb life. Others explored gas-based bulbs, leading to energy-saving lamps. Lasers, once Einstein's theory, became essential tech. Today, lighting innovations include invisible wavelengths and even laser therapy. What's next in the evolution of light?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Water covers 71% of the Earth's surface and is the medium of life. All life forms and their surrounding ecosystems are dependent upon water, without it we would cease to exist. Director of Notre Dame's Environmental Change Initiative, Dr. David Lodge examines the infestations that are spreading throughout our fresh and salt water systems and clogging our precious waterways.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: This episode tackles a universal threat: epidemics and pandemics. Unlike earthquakes or floods, disease can strike anywhere and spread globally in a flash. Recent fears of pandemics feel more real than ever. We examine Ebola and Cholera in Africa, SARS and Bird Flu in Asia, and the resurgence of Cholera despite past victories. Smallpox may be gone, but vigilance is key—epidemics ignore borders. Survival depends on individual care and collective action against outbreaks.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Go for launch! We visit Space Shuttle Endeavor at the California Science Center. Then, we check out the glitch and glamour at the Hollywood Museum. We'll learn about the Holocaust at the Holocaust Museum and Japanese Internment during WWII at the Japanese/American National Museum. After that, we dig for bones at the famous La Brea Tar Pits.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Up, up and away! We discover St. Petersburg Florida's aviation roots at the St.Pete History Museum. Then, comb your mustache, we visit the Dali Museum to look at Salvador Dali's amazing masterworks. We'll dredge the deep looking for sponges, and defend the bay at Fort Desoto.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Fishing Prince Rupert, Ha-Nee-Nah Lodge on Dundas Island and Hecate Strait for Chinook Salmon and Pacific Halibut!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy's ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia's wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Bangalore is a city with many names: the Garden City, the Pub City, the Fashion Capital the list goes on. Follow Bill as he journeys through this city of contrasts and touches on its many faces. We visit Cubbon Park and Lal Bagh Gardens, shop in the markets and explore the nightlife of the modern city. We also explore architecture, from ancient Bull Temple, the legendary source of the Vishva Bharti River to the largest legislative building in India. Bill's final stop is the "Queen of the Hill Stations" Ooty, where he tours the plantations, rides the historic narrow-gauge railroad and visits the Stone House, which was built by the British in the days of colonial rule.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: These two national parks have some of the most diverse wildlife found on the Indian subcontinent. From the ancestors of our domesticated livestock to leopards, bear and elephants—this is a photographer's paradise. Join Bill as he attempts to track down two of the hardest predators to photograph—the leopard and the sloth bear.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: All the essentials for going on, and having a successful safari are covered before our host gets a very special challenge—to find at least half of the "Big Twelve" on one safari drive. Four hours and six (6) very special animals—can he do it using his own rules for a successful safari?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: We elect to stay on a few extra days to try and obtain some good leopard footage. These are the most elusive of the "Big Twelve" and filming them is a major challenge. In the process of tracking leopards, we run across a newborn gazelle trying to walk for the first time. Will it succeed before the predators find it? Can we find and film a leopard up close?

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: First people to free ski big mountain lines in Japan. Long travel times to Japan and ski opportunities were not the only obstacles on their way to explore Japan's backcountry.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: This episode will follow "Team Cannondale" riders as they explore the European Alps, and all it has to offer for the mountain bike culture.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live

programme.title: Mediterranean, In the Cetacean Footsteps
programme.desc: This documentary explores the paths of knowledge of Mediterranean Cetaceans. With scientists, veterinarians, representatives of associations, amateur or professional fishermen, we discover these mammals as well as major issues looming over their presence in this particular area of the globe. Through their very survival in the Mediterranean Sea we have a natural barometer of the "health level" of the local ecosystem. We focus on follow various peoples during their missions on a daily basis. All with a clear stated desire in mind, that being to look through the prism of this human mosaic working on the species survival... and thus contributing on sustainable development. This assembly has the potential to increase by tenfold the general public interest towards these sea creatures.

programme.title: European Identities
programme.desc: What is European Identity? Is it cultural or political? Thibault Bourdon travels 8500 Km on his bicycle crossing multitude of dialects & landscapes, majestic mountains, stunning cliffs across the continent exploring this political & economic cohesion of 750 million people. In the end, the project of the European Union is a beautiful idea but, for Europeans.

programme.title: Islands In A Desert Sea
programme.desc: Baja California _ a 1000 mile long desert peninsula. The Sea of Cortez, separating it from the Mexican mainland, is studded with islands, large and small.It's a sea teeming with lifeThe islands may be barren but oceanic upwellings draw in massive schools of fishAnd this richness attracts the inevitable predators. Biologically speaking, this is the richest body of water on our entire planet. The calm waters among the islands are perfect breeding grounds, creatures migrating thousands of miles to spawn their next generation here. Primeval forces draw giants here on an annual migration from frozen northern seas. Other creatures also travel thousands of miles to nest here on tiny dots in the ocean. The sea of Cortez has been relentlessly exploited by man, driving some species to the brink of extinction. Yet this almost land-locked sea also provides evidence of the remarkable resilience of the ocean. And it also shows us how we humans can sometimes make a difference...

programme.title: Under the Lights: Pele
programme.desc: A biography of the greatest player of all time on the pitch and one of the most iconic legends in sport.

programme.title: Man Eaters
programme.desc: The first documentary about the Human-leopard conflict in Sri Lanka, "Man Eaters: A Human Leopard Story" approaches the conflict by analyzing past and present cases of man-eating leopards in Sri Lanka and what led to their strange behavior. Unlike India, man-eating leopards in Sri Lanka are very rare.

programme.title: Yemen - Kids and the War
programme.desc: It is an exceptional documentary, filmed in a country no camera can penetrate _ a world exclusive. In a context in which the biggest international networks are unable to present images of this forgotten war, the Yemeni director Khadija Al Salami has entrusted her camera to 3 children who become war correspondents for this documentary in Yemen. Ahmed is 11, Rima is 8 and Youssef is 9. It is them who will recount the daily life of theYemeni people under Saudi airstrikes. They meet other kids, collecting the testimonies of wounded children in hospital and those who lost their parents in the airstrikes. With the innocence of children, they also interview adults _ a painter, a rapper, a model who has become "Miss War" on social media _ and ask them to send a message to those who they believe are the only ones who can stop the war _ the EuropeanUnion. Constructed like a story tale, with no images of violence, this deeply moving documentary shows the cruel reality of war through the eyes of children, and the incredible hope that they place in Europe to put an end to the conflict.

programme.title: The Solomon Treasures
programme.desc: The discovery in Jerusalem in 2007 of a tomb said to belong to the family of Jesus of Nazareth is just the latest in a long line of extraordinary finds which have recently come to light in the Holy Land. But not all these finds are quite what they seem. Both a stone tablet said to come from the Temple of Solomon, and an ossuary apparently belonging to the brother of Jesus, have been declared fakes. The official investigation then uncovered dozens of other fakes, and attention eventually focussed on one of the most revered objects in Israel: the ivory pomegranate. This artefact has been in the Israel Museum for nearly twenty years. Like the stone tablet, it too was linked to the Temple of Solomon _ and astonishingly it too, investigators concluded, was fake. As forensic scientists now turn their attention to the ossuaries from the 'Jesus family tomb', Israeli archaeologists are left fearing that history and science is being repeatedly distorted, and they face a challenge to separate fact from fiction.

programme.title: Unstoppable: The Fentanyl Epidemic
programme.desc: Canadians' attention has been briefly grabbed by the headline: the story an abnormally high number of overdose deaths caused by a drug called fentanyl. It merited a few days attention and then was pushed off the stage by other concerns. What Canadians failed to appreciate was that those few headlines offered a foreboding glimpse of what might be one of the most destructive waves of illegal drugs to hit North America since Pablo Escobar flooded the continent with cheap and powerful cocaine. Fentanyl is a killer. And fentanyl isn't just preying on the addict population of this country. Its victims are also Canada's unsuspecting middle-class. And the epidemic is showing no signs of letting up. In fact all signs point to the death count rising as more and more powerful versions of this drug seep into the country.The result, Canadians have no idea what's "slouching" towards them in the near future. Through the eyes of four insiders in the fentanyl industry, Dam Builder Productions will take the audience inside this world in way that will enlighten, outrage, and even fascinate.

programme.title: Remote Control War
programme.desc: The current campaigns in Iraq and Afghanistan are the world's first Robotic War, with over 7,000 robots in the air and 12,000 on the ground. Warfare has been revolutionised in a monumental shift. Mankind's five thousand year monopoly on war is breaking down. Robotic war is here.

programme.title: Trouble in Lemur Land
programme.desc: High up in the mountains of north-eastern Madagascar lives one of the world's most critically endangered primates. There are less than a thousand Silky Sifakas alive today and this area of remote rainforest, known as Marojejy-Anjanaharibe-Sud, is their only home.In the past, the rugged terrain here kept the Silkies relatively safe but things are now changing at an alarming pace. This magical place is under serious threat from illegal logging operations as international demand for highly sought-after rosewood and ebony increases. Unscrupulous logging gangs are encroaching on the Silkies' last remaining habitat."Trouble in Lemur Land" follows two men, an American primatologist and a Malagasy conservationist, on their quest to protect this rare species, at the same time providing a rare glimpse into the life of this extraordinarily beautiful and graceful animal.The film centres around the arrival of two babies in the group _ a glimmer of hope in an otherwise desperate situation. Lemur reproduction rates are slow and Silkies only mate one day in the year, so it is a very special moment when primatologist Erik Patel sees the newborns for the first time. He has a permanent camp on the ou

programme.title: In the Darkness
programme.desc: An immersion in the heart of the biggest West-African prison: Abidjan. Located out of sight at the border of the Banco forest, this prison host 5,000 inmates but has capacity for 1,500. With the inmates' help, life inside is organized, and a degree of stability exists.

programme.title: Colonies Under the Sea
programme.desc: The film follows four unique divers as they explore shipwrecks in the heart of the Bahamas archipelago in order to discover the unexpected life they harbor.

programme.title: Remote Control War
programme.desc: The current campaigns in Iraq and Afghanistan are the world's first Robotic War, with over 7,000 robots in the air and 12,000 on the ground. Warfare has been revolutionised in a monumental shift. Mankind's five thousand year monopoly on war is breaking down. Robotic war is here.

programme.title: Mefloquine
programme.desc: Developed by the US Army after Vietnam to combat malaria in troops, Mefloquine became available to the public in the 90s. However, in the following decades it became most well-known for reports of its serious psychiatric side effects. Questions about why it has been so widely and easily dispensed have been raised for some time. The director's personal investigation seeks to understand why those affected have been left in the dark for so long. In doing so he uncovers some surprising truths about the powerful players involved in this controversial drug's story.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: This show features some segments that didn't fit in their respective episodes. We play around at the Pinball Museum in Las Vegas. Then, we salute the Commander in Chief at the Presidential Hall of Fame in Clermont, FL. Also, we'll swim with real mermaids at Weeki Wachee Springs in Central Florida, and cheer on Teddy Ballgame at the Ted Williams Hitters Hall of Fame.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: O Say can you see? We're in Baltimore, MD. We'll learn about the Battle of Baltimore at Fort McHenry and the inspiration of the Star Spangled Banner. Then we dig deep into the history of Baltimore's most famous resident, Edgar Allan Poe. We'll sift through a huge collection of pop art and collectibles at the Geppi Museum, and learn about cracking codes at the National Cryptology museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Running the Portland Canal from Prince Rupert to Alaska...and fishing Alaskan Halibut!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Join us as we explore the Gateway to India—Mumbai. From its early history, it's many foreign occupations to the hustle and bustle of today. Bill tells Mumbai's rich history is told through two of its most famous inhabitants, Gandhi and Kipling. We delve into the community of the Parsi faith and learn about their beliefs regarding the circle of life before heading to a little bit of heaven on earth, the coastal paradise of Goa. This hot spot for "in the know" travelers feature white, sandy beaches and is surrounded by tropical plant life. Bill introduces both the armchair and actual traveler to this incredible destination. We explore the Portuguese influence on Goa's architecture and cuisine, tour the ghost city of Old Goa and explore Roman Catholic churches.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Where can you find literally hundreds of Jain Temples, a lost civilization and one of the top birding destinations in the world—the Bhavnagar region of course. Follow Bill as he attempts to climb 4000 steps to the great Jain temples of Palitana, floats through a lagoon full of flamingoes, egrets and cranes and learns about a kingdom lost to history.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Nicknamed the Garden of Eden, this volcanic caldera is home to over 25,000 big game animals. Here survival isn't just a game—it's a matter of life and death. You'll witness one of the great acts of nature—buffalo, lion and hyena in a face-to-face struggle for dominance. Life in the crater can take surprising twists.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: One of the most modern cities in Africa, Cape Town has something for everyone. We explore the city's architecture, taste a little wine at nearby Vineyards and track down the only penguin species in Africa before reaching the fabled Cape of Good Hope…just a scenic drive outside the city proper.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Kitesurfing is a sport that could not be better suited to an island location like Tahiti. With the sun, sand and an ocean breeze it is an ideal spot to spread your kite and surf.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Follow a group of extreme skiers as they explore Jackson Hole a Mecca for snow sports of all kind.

programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim
